2. Convert 40 liters to gallons: call liter_to_gallon with liter=40. That returns gallons.

3. Fill fuel tank: call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount equal to converted gallons.

We need to round the fill amount to two decimal places. So after conversion, round to two decimals before calling fillFuelTank.

Thus sequence: estimate_distance -> liter_to_gallon -> round -> fillFuelTank.
